pages.title: Avalonia bindings published for D
pages.description: A D process can host Avalonia windows through a C ABI, with ShadUI for shadcn-style controls.

pages.title: Hosting Avalonia from D
pages.description: Avalonia stays primitive; ShadUI already cloned shadcn. The D-shaped problem is hosting .NET, not restyling buttons.

pages.title: Thread-local GC proposed upstream
pages.description: Opt-in per-thread collector submitted to dlang/dmd on 2 August 2026.

pages.title: Isolating heaps as threads isolate data
pages.description: Why D’s actor-ish threads still share one GC heap, and what an opt-in per-thread collector would change.
